asof_note: The guilt-free plan: pay-yourself-first, one everyday amount, two named funds. The dashboard's FUNDS constant is a copy of this file (check_data D13). Fields that render on the page are English.

flows.name: Take-home pay
flows.note: Payroll of $1,800 twice a month. Investment income stays with the broker and is not counted.

flows.name: Rent
flows.note: Pre-authorized on the 1st, from chequing. Still there after FIRE.

flows.name: Invest
flows.note: Off the top, before anything else — pay-yourself-first.

flows.name: Everyday
flows.note: The guilt-free line. No categories and no caps below it.

plan.leftoverNote: Each closed month adds (everyday - everyday spending) to the fund, and that figure is signed: an over month takes from Big buys first, then Travel.

opening.note: Not a transfer — a label on money already in that account, so the goal is met on day one and the discipline is leaving it alone.

backing.label: Wealthsimple High yield savings (Non-registered)
backing.holds: SGOV and VSC, not cash — spending it means selling first
backing.note: Rule 2 already treats this account as earmarked, so naming part of it Travel changes no other number on the dashboard.

claimsAgainst.source: Each fund names the account it is claimed against, and the claims have to fit inside that account
claimsAgainst.note: Neither fund is an account of its own. Both are labels on one savings account.
